entities.summary: The Engineer Troops of the Russian Federation are a Combat Arm and military administrative corps of the Russian Ground Forces of the Russian Federation designed to perform military engineering operations, requiring special training of personnel and use of means of engineer equipment, as well as for damaging the enemy through application of engineer ammunition.
